findings.conclusion: The four target nodes all have authored PlayVoice=true and TalkAkEvent=null. Original voice lookup uses TidTalk/TextKey to resolve PlotAudio; script ID, speaker name and displayed text are not media-name generators.

1001:1 EVENT_AVGmain_1_1 and 1002:1 EVENT_AVGmain_5_1 are distinct dialogue keys whose explicit PlotAudio FileName both equals vo_EVENT_AVGmain_1_1. 1002:2 explicitly selects vo_EVENT_AVGmain_5_2. Shared media must not merge dialogue history or line keys.

Speaker 701290 resolves to the literal English ???. Reader voice resolution has no speaker gate; native VoiceSpeakerId associates an already successful voice with a speaker rather than selecting its media.

At this inspection all four targets have no manifest.lines entry, guaranteeing silence independent of timing or user gesture. Recorded failures distinguish Chisa stored SHA1 mismatch from empty train decoder errors.

The baseline discards a current voice request before manifest readiness or first-unlock completion; Review replay at its first gesture has the same loss. Three frozen mock-source probes produce zero source starts, while the ready positive control starts exactly once.

The Reader configures the scene and runs first-node t=0 stage operations before delivering that first dialogue. Both train intros retain DialogDelay=0.08 as raw metadata, but no source consumer reads that field, so it cannot itself suppress voice. The runner publishes its final snapshot before event subscribers receive the batch.

Native and Reader Review resolve the explicit dialogue key with the effective audio language and original gender flags. Current installed playback language is ja. Replay explicitly unlocks then starts its resolved media; closing Reader History calls stopVoice.

recommendedRegressionCases: Current dialogue arrives before deferred manifest; release produces exactly one current source without redelivering dialogue.
First-gesture normal line and Review replay arrive before deferred AudioContext.resume; each starts once on completion.
New line replaces old pending request, including repeated script/nid with a new visit token; only newest may start.
Navigation, stage end, scene/run change, restore, dispose and Review close invalidate pending requests and late decode completion.
Pending resolution uses the selected supported language/gender at flush; no unrelated-language fallback or resurrection.
Checkpoint restore rebuilds durable loops without automatic voice; explicit resolved historical Review replay remains available.
Four literal source keys stay distinct; the authored _5_1 to _1_1 media alias is preserved and _5_2 stays separate.

testGap.detail: Every existing harness.ready awaits audio.load and a tick after unlock, masking both first-readiness losses. The existing late-decode, scene, restore and fast-forward regressions remain meaningful.
